pending_spares.note: Each consuming row has its own undecided approval, printed by urls as spare:<row>. The approval-pending fixture itself is never decided, so its read-only review matrix (themes, viewports, zoom, keyboard) never consumes it.
pending_spares.reseed: Every pending approval, spares included, stays pending for 900 seconds after seeding. When a pending row's window lapses before its check is done, run reset, up and seed again (about three minutes) and continue with the new URLs from urls; nothing else changes.

steps: Submit one ordinary approve or refuse form and observe its native pending state before the server result returns. This consumes that spare only.

steps: Open the same pending approval in two ordinary tabs.
Decide it in the first tab.
Submit the second tab's stale form and observe the fresh-preview refusal with no mutation or resubmission.

approval-denied-or-missing.route: a seeded approval URL from workspace A (the state file's workspaces.a)
steps: Open the real approval URL as its same human in workspace A and record the positive control.
Switch that host-bound human session normally to the seeded workspace B with the existing workspace switcher.
Reopen the unchanged workspace-A approval URL and observe the genuine fully redacted result.
Switch normally back to workspace A and reopen the unchanged URL as the final positive control.
Run current-omitted: it recreates only this project's core with the Current module left out of its loaded module list.
Open the seeded live item/live project Leads URL (either variant) and observe both Current branches reported unavailable with no Current link or content.
Run current-restored and confirm the same URL shows the live item and project again.
handoff-unavailable-item-unavailable-pro.constraints: Deployment configuration of the unique disposable project only. No network fault proxy, no product, auth, routing or permission change, no direct table write.

steps: Run core-stop: it stops only this project's core while the web app keeps serving.
Reload the unchanged seeded approval URL and observe Approval temporarily unavailable with no decision controls.
Run core-start and confirm the same URL shows the approval again.
approval-temporarily-unavailable.constraints: Stops the unique disposable project's own core service. No network fault proxy, no fake URL.
